nodes.name: Chunk Trigger
nodes.notes: The Supersoniq chunk worker of Enrich Contacts (2026-09-09): one chunk of companies in (the lane contract plus companies), Supersoniq asked at its documented pace, the people handed to Enrich Contacts Writer (awaited), counters out. Its own execution, so its payloads die with it.

nodes.name: SQ Enrich
nodes.notes: Supersoniq companies/enrich, up to 1,000 domains a call, per_company_limit 10, seniors only, tier full so the email rides. One credit per delivered contact.
